title: CGI Moon Kit — 2025 LROC color map
data: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC) Wide Angle Camera Hapke-normalized mosaic; polar fill from Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter albedo
projection: global longitude-latitude equirectangular color map centered on 0 degrees longitude
mapping_note: Center longitude confirmed by NASA source. Renderer must independently validate east/west handedness, lunar pole orientation and libration; a fixed front-facing texture is not an exact lunar attitude model.

rights.basis: NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines
rights.status: NASA SVS item supplies this map for 3D rendering with NASA SVS credit. No separate third-party restriction was identified on the item. Do not imply endorsement or relicense as application MIT.

limitations: NASA describes this map as optimized for aesthetics, not science.
Color/exposure and white balance are adjusted; high-latitude gaps are filled.
This is a historical compiled lunar surface texture, not a live observation or calibrated display brightness.
Downloading this asset does not validate a renderer, surface orientation, phase model, angular scale or local visibility.
changes: None; downloaded ready-sized original JPEG bytes, no image editing, cropping, resizing or transcoding.
